mapper.insert: insert into tbl_widget_token (member_number, token, scope, label, created_at) values (#{memberNumber}, #{token}, #{scope}, #{label}, now())
mapper.select: select token_id, member_number, token, scope, label, created_at, last_used_at, revoked_at from tbl_widget_token where member_number = #{memberNumber} order by created_at desc

select wt.token_id, wt.member_number, tm.member_name, wt.token, wt.scope, wt.label, wt.created_at, wt.last_used_at, wt.revoked_at from tbl_widget_token wt join tbl_member tm on tm.member_number = wt.member_number order by wt.created_at desc
